details: Bitcoin has shown resilience in July 2026, recovering from a recent selloff and stabilizing above the $58,000 support level. This recovery is supported by renewed ETF inflows, softer US employment data, and growing optimism around US crypto legislation, particularly the CLARITY Act, which could encourage greater institutional participation. Prediction markets indicate a strong likelihood of Bitcoin prices exceeding $56,000 by July 13.
title: Bitcoin Recovers Amid ETF Inflows, Regulatory Hopes

details: Robinhood has launched its Layer-2 solution, Robinhood Chain, sparking optimism for Ethereum as it aims to expand decentralized finance (DeFi) access and tokenize real-world assets using ETH as the native gas token. This development coincides with spot Ethereum ETFs recording $84.42 million in net inflows for the week ending July 11, 2026, breaking an eight-week streak of outflows. ETH is trading around $1,804.
title: Robinhood Chain Boosts ETH; Ethereum ETFs See Inflows

details: Michael Saylor, CEO of Strategy (MicroStrategy), has indicated a shift from his previous "never sell" stance by confirming the sale of $216 million worth of Bitcoin to support dividends. This move comes as Robinhood's Layer-2 launch also influences the broader crypto market.
title: Saylor Shifts Stance, MicroStrategy Sells BTC

details: The stablecoin market capitalization experienced its largest dollar decline in nearly four years during June, dropping by $7.7 billion. This downturn, reported by CoinDesk, signals a dip in on-chain liquidity as cryptocurrency markets continue to consolidate near their yearly lows.
title: Stablecoin Market Cap Declines $7.7B in June

details: XRP saw a slight dip to $1.10 as capital defensively rotated out of altcoins and into Bitcoin, causing broader altcoin weakness. However, SWIFT has reportedly tapped over 30 banks connected to Ripple's ecosystem to enhance cross-border payments, representing a positive fundamental development for XRP's utility.
title: XRP Dips, SWIFT Integrates Ripple-Linked Banks

details: Rising geopolitical tensions, including renewed US-Iran hostilities, are fueling global inflation concerns and a "risk-off" sentiment across financial markets, impacting cryptocurrencies. Additionally, markets are closely watching for the release of June's Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation data on Tuesday, which could introduce further volatility to crypto and traditional markets.
title: Macro Factors Weigh on Crypto: US-Iran, CPI
